services.name: Evening Colors Sunset Sail
services.desc: Join us on the harbor! 2 Hours About An absolute “Seattle Must Do!” We will set the sails, turn off the engine, and relax as the cool sea breeze powers us through the Puget Sound. Enjoy a drink as the sun dips down behind the Olympic Peninsula and bathes the Seattle skyline in sparkling twilight colors. This is the perfect cruise for special occasions and dates. Our amazing sailboat is the largest and most comfortable public sailing vessel in Seattle. We have comfortable seats for relaxing and wide decks to enjoy moving around the vessel. services.name: Seattle Sailing Harbor Tour
services.desc: Join us on the harbor! 2 Hours About Come aboard for a day sail on our classic schooner! Our Harbor Sailing tour is family-friendly and is an excellent way to see the Seattle skyline, the beauty of the Puget Sound, and even mountain views! We will depart from our dock at Pier 66 Bell Harbor Marina, then set our sails for a 2-hour cruise in the Puget Sound. Bay Lady is the largest public sailing vessel in Seattle. Start your weekend morning off right with a morning adventure aboard Seattle’s Tall Ship as we set sail and enjoy a delicious brunch buffet. Indulge in the perfect combination of relaxation, breathtaking views, and a mouthwatering buffet prepared by Arista Catering. blurb: Guests sail aboard the Bay Lady, an 85-foot traditional gaff-rigged schooner, for public tours including harbor sails, sunset sails, and brunch buffets. The ship accommodates up to 87 passengers and offers a family-friendly experience with onboard bathrooms and a drink/snack bar. Private charters are available for events such as weddings and corporate gatherings.
